skill.name: skill-publishing-guide
skill.description: Use when preparing, publishing, updating, or verifying an Agent Skill on GitHub, skills.sh, Tencent SkillHub (skillhub.cn), SkillHub (skillhub.club), Skillstore, ClawHub, or community directories, especially when repo URLs, ZIP layouts, review states, or release versions differ. 适用于 Skill 上架、分发、版本更新和发布结果核验。
skill.summary: Prepare, publish, update, and verify Agent Skills across eight distribution channels with traceable packages and separate content checks.
skill.author: hunxuankai

security_audit.summary: All 19 static findings are false positives involving readable multilingual documentation, Markdown formatting, placeholder links, or authorized publishing commands. The guide explicitly limits remote writes, protects credentials, and separates preparation from publication. content.value_statement: Skill marketplaces accept different inputs and expose separate review, package, and listing states. This guide helps prepare scoped releases and verify each result with traceable evidence.
actual_capabilities: Guide publication through GitHub, skills.sh, Tencent SkillHub, SkillHub.club, Skillstore, ClawHub, VoltAgent, and Agensi.
Define a single skill release scope and prepare channel-specific URL or ZIP inputs with source references and hashes.
Prepare platform summaries and full overview text that reflect actual functionality, dependencies, system support, and verification limits.
Guide authorized CLI and browser workflows while separating local preparation, remote drafts, uploads, review, and public release.
Compare public versions, available package files, summaries, and overview text against the selected release.
Produce submission records and recovery steps for unknown results, duplicate versions, filtered files, and stale listings.
limitations: The skill provides Markdown guidance and templates, not a bundled publishing service or executable automation.
Publishing requires appropriate tools, authentication, permissions, and user authorization for external changes.
Platform rules and interfaces can change; documented observations require confirmation before use.
The guide cannot guarantee acceptance, review timing, complete file delivery, or automatic listing synchronization.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first skill release
use_cases.description: Identify the correct submission route and prepare a complete skill package, summary, and overview before any upload.

use_cases.title: Coordinate marketplace updates
use_cases.description: Track source commits, author versions, platform revisions, package hashes, and listing changes across authorized channels.

use_cases.title: Verify a reported publication
use_cases.description: Check public identity, target version, available files, and listing text without treating upload receipts as proof of publication.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a publishing route
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to publish [skill path] to [platform]. Identify required inputs and checks. Do not upload, log in, or change remote state.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand one channel before preparing a release.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare local release materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare [skill path] at [source ref] for [platform]. Check dependencies, license, package layout, summary, and full overview. Keep all work local.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a scoped package and complete listing text.

prompt_templates.title: Publish an authorized update
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [namespace/slug] on [platform] using [source ref] and author version [version]. I authorize uploading and publishing this skill only. Preserve visibility and license. Check package and listing content before submission, then report each verification result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: execute a defined update within existing publishing permissions.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate an uncertain submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [submission ID or URL] after [timeout or conflict]. Use read-only checks first. Correlate identity, version, source, package, summary, and overview. Report evidence and unknowns. Do not retry, rename, bump versions, or recreate entries without authorization.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover from ambiguous results without duplicate releases.

output_examples.input: Prepare one skill from a repository containing several skills for GitHub and Skillstore. Do not publish.
output: Scope: include only the selected skill and its required resources.
GitHub preparation: build a single-skill release archive and record its source commit, path, author version, and SHA-256.
Skillstore preparation: select the intended public GitHub directory URL and check the discovery scope before submission.
Listing materials: prepare the complete summary and overview with dependencies and verification limits.
Execution boundary: no remote repository, release, upload, or submission is authorized.

output_examples.input: The target version is publicly visible and the summary is current, but the overview still describes the previous version. Assess completion.
output: Overview: outdated and incomplete for this release.
Overall result: publication verification remains incomplete.
Next step: identify the overview source and authorized update route, then verify the full public text and package separately.

best_practices: Fix the selected skill, source ref, author version, license, and authorized channels before building or submitting materials.
Recheck current official rules and compare the actual upload file list with required resources before remote writes.
Record package, version, summary, and overview results separately, with evidence dates and explicit unknowns.
anti_patterns: Uploading an entire repository when the user selected only one skill.
Treating an upload receipt, successful command, or visible old version as proof that the complete new release is public.
Retrying ambiguous writes by renaming, incrementing versions, deleting entries, or repeating uploads without checking existing records.

faq.question: Which publishing channels does this guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers GitHub, skills.sh, Tencent SkillHub, SkillHub.club, Skillstore, ClawHub, VoltAgent, and Agensi.

faq.question: Can I prepare a release without logging in?
faq.answer: Yes. Local package checks, source records, summaries, full overviews, and publishing plans can be prepared before authentication.

faq.question: Does uploading a ZIP also update the listing overview?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Package files, summaries, custom overviews, and translations may use separate submission and display mechanisms.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically publish everywhere?
faq.answer: No. It follows the selected channels and authorized actions. Tools and valid platform access are required for actual publication.

faq.question: Does every marketplace use the same ZIP layout?
faq.answer: No. Check current channel rules and inspect normalized file paths, dependencies, filters, and the actual accepted file list.

faq.question: What should I do after a submission timeout?
faq.answer: Record the request identity and check existing platform records first. Keep the result unknown until evidence supports retrying or confirms completion.
